description:
LEVELS OF ASSISTANCE Five levels of assistance allow you to optimally manage the electric assistance, together with the Walk Assistance mode which allows you to have an easier start on uphill sections or with loaded bags. MOTOR The Rear HUB hub motor develops a power of 250W and a torque of 45 Nm at a low weight of just over 3 kg. Compact and versatile, it does not require any particular ordinary maintenance interventions. BATTERY BE02 FATTY is equipped with an integrated removable 504 Wh battery for a range of up to 80 km.

BE GREEN TECHNOLOGIES The 20" frame can be conveniently folded using the hinge located in front of the bottom bracket area, as can the handlebar which folds along the fork, to make it compact and easily loadable into the car. The oversized tires guarantee greater driving stability even on dirt roads and uneven ground. The 7-speed Shimano gearbox guarantees a pleasant ride in all conditions, even uphill, allowing fatigue to be reduced to a minimum. Rack, fenders, and lights make it particularly versatile and ready for adventure. IDEAL FOR The BE02 FATTY is particularly comfortable on urban routes, but also on light dirt roads and uneven pavement. It's perfect for daily commuting thanks to its comfortable and stable ride and accessories for carrying everything you need. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you are looking for a fun and versatile e-bike for your daily commute, which allows you to tackle mixed routes without difficulty.
